utility.name: LLM API relay
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: An nginx reverse proxy that lets lab VMs on an isolated network use the local LLMs (an OpenAI-compatible API such as the Spark LLM gateway) without joining the internal network. Only the chat completions and model list endpoints are relayed, and the relay can add the API key itself so that no key is stored on a student VM. Clients use http://<relay IP>:<listen_port>/api/v1/ as their base URL (e.g. the ghidra module's llm_relay_ip input). On Proxmox the system keeps its provisioning NIC (net0, the internal network) after the build: the keep_provisioning_nic type below tells SecGen not to remove it. Put this module on a system students don't control (e.g. the Hackerbot server).
